changes._why: the inner join to Inventory dropped a component with no stock, so a futon missing one still counted as buildable; Codex's, with a finished good without a BOM shown as NULL and a negative stock as 0
request: How many of each finished futon the components available in WH-MAIN can build: for each direct component, how many times its quantity is available, none where WH-MAIN does not stock it, and the smallest of those; scrap is not counted.
A futon without an active bill of materials shows NULL.
changes.sql:
SELECT p.ItemCode,
       p.ItemName,
       MIN(FLOOR(CASE WHEN v.QuantityAvailable > 0 THEN v.QuantityAvailable ELSE 0 END / b.Quantity)) AS Buildable
FROM Items p
         JOIN ItemType t ON t.ItemTypeID = p.ItemTypeID
         LEFT JOIN BillOfMaterials b ON b.ParentItemID = p.ItemID AND b.IsActive = 1
         LEFT JOIN Inventory v ON v.ItemID = b.ComponentItemID
    AND v.WarehouseID = (SELECT w.WarehouseID FROM Warehouse w WHERE w.WarehouseCode = 'WH-MAIN')
WHERE t.TypeCode = 'FG'
GROUP BY p.ItemID, p.ItemCode, p.ItemName
ORDER BY Buildable DESC, p.ItemCode

changes._why: <> 'Delivered' also returned cancelled orders, and SQL Server put the orders with no requested date first
request: The orders not delivered yet and not cancelled, the earliest requested delivery date first, the orders without one last.
changes.sql:
SELECT so.OrderNumber, c.CustomerName, so.Status, so.RequestedDeliveryDate, so.NetAmount
FROM SalesOrder so
         JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerID = so.CustomerID
WHERE so.Status NOT IN ('Delivered', 'Cancelled')
ORDER BY CASE WHEN so.RequestedDeliveryDate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, so.RequestedDeliveryDate, so.OrderNumber

changes._why: a row is an item in a warehouse, but the warehouse was neither shown nor ordered, so two rows could tie and TOP (5) cut between them
request: The five stocks, an item in a warehouse, with the lowest ratio of the quantity available to the reorder point, for the items whose reorder point is above 0; a tie is broken by the item code and the warehouse code.
changes.sql:
SELECT TOP (5) i.ItemCode,
               i.ItemName,
               w.WarehouseCode,
               v.QuantityAvailable,
               i.ReorderPoint,
               CAST(v.QuantityAvailable / i.ReorderPoint AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS Ratio
FROM Inventory v
         JOIN Items i ON i.ItemID = v.ItemID
         JOIN Warehouse w ON w.WarehouseID = v.WarehouseID
WHERE i.ReorderPoint > 0
ORDER BY v.QuantityAvailable / i.ReorderPoint, i.ItemCode, w.WarehouseCode

changes._why: 'on receipt' is InspectionType 'Incoming', which the query did not ask for; the share divided by a sum that may be 0
request: The share of what was inspected on receipt, `InspectionType` `Incoming`, that was rejected, for each supplier, the worst first; an inspection names its purchase order by number, not by a foreign key, and a share is NULL where nothing was inspected.
changes.sql:
SELECT s.SupplierCode,
       s.SupplierName,
       SUM(q.QuantityInspected) AS Inspected,
       SUM(q.QuantityRejected) AS Rejected,
       CAST(SUM(q.QuantityRejected) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(q.QuantityInspected), 0) AS DECIMAL(9, 2)) AS RejectedPercent
FROM PurchaseOrder po
         JOIN Supplier s ON s.SupplierID = po.SupplierID
         JOIN QualityInspection q ON q.ReferenceType = 'PO' AND q.ReferenceNumber = po.PONumber AND q.InspectionType = 'Incoming'
GROUP BY s.SupplierID, s.SupplierCode, s.SupplierName
ORDER BY RejectedPercent DESC, s.SupplierCode

changes._why: cancelled orders counted as sales (Claude); a channel with no order was left out, and equal amounts had no tie-break (Codex); the cancelled ones go out in the outer join's condition
request: The number of orders not cancelled and their net amount, for every sales channel, `0` for a channel without one, the largest first; channels with the same amount are ordered by code.
changes.sql:
SELECT ch.ChannelCode,
       ch.ChannelName,
       COUNT(so.SalesOrderID)         AS Orders,
       COALESCE(SUM(so.NetAmount), 0) AS NetAmount
FROM SalesChannel ch
         LEFT JOIN SalesOrder so ON so.SalesChannelID = ch.SalesChannelID AND so.Status <> 'Cancelled'
GROUP BY ch.SalesChannelID, ch.ChannelCode, ch.ChannelName
ORDER BY NetAmount DESC, ch.ChannelCode

changes._why: it counted every item of an order line, not only futons, and the lines of cancelled orders
request: The three futons sold the most, by quantity, on orders not cancelled, with the net amount of their lines.
changes.sql:
SELECT TOP (3) i.ItemCode, i.ItemName, SUM(d.Quantity) AS Quantity, SUM(d.NetAmount) AS NetAmount
FROM SalesOrderDetail d
         JOIN SalesOrder so ON so.SalesOrderID = d.SalesOrderID
         JOIN Items i ON i.ItemID = d.ItemID
         JOIN ItemType t ON t.ItemTypeID = i.ItemTypeID
WHERE t.TypeCode = 'FG'
  AND so.Status <> 'Cancelled'
GROUP BY i.ItemID, i.ItemCode, i.ItemName
ORDER BY Quantity DESC, i.ItemCode

changes._why: the running total added the net amount of cancelled orders
request: The orders of the wholesale customers, cancelled ones left out, each with the running total of its customer's net amount, in the order of their dates.
changes.sql:
SELECT c.CustomerCode,
       so.OrderNumber,
       so.OrderDate,
       so.NetAmount,
       SUM(so.NetAmount) OVER (PARTITION BY so.CustomerID ORDER BY so.OrderDate, so.SalesOrderID ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS RunningTotal
FROM SalesOrder so
         JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerID = so.CustomerID
WHERE c.CustomerType = 'Wholesale'
  AND so.Status <> 'Cancelled'
ORDER BY c.CustomerCode, so.OrderDate, so.SalesOrderID

changes._why: SupplierItem keeps dated rows with no unique key on supplier and item, so an item came back twice, once with an ended price
request: The items a supplier, SUP-002, supplies now, its offers not ended, with its price beside the item's standard cost.
changes.sql:
SELECT i.ItemCode, i.ItemName, si.UnitPrice, i.StandardCost, si.MinimumOrderQuantity, si.LeadTimeDays
FROM SupplierItem si
         JOIN Supplier s ON s.SupplierID = si.SupplierID
         JOIN Items i ON i.ItemID = si.ItemID
WHERE s.SupplierCode = 'SUP-002'
  AND si.EndDate IS NULL
ORDER BY i.ItemCode

changes._why: a component at the end of the explosion is not always a raw material; a raw material with no stock showed no availability instead of 0
request: The raw materials, `RAW`, ten FG-FUT-003 futons need through every active level of the bill of materials, each level's scrap included, and how much of each is available across the warehouses, `0` where none is stocked.
changes.sql:
WITH Explosion AS (SELECT b.ComponentItemID, CAST(10 * b.Quantity * (1 + b.ScrapRate / 100) AS DECIMAL(28, 8)) AS Quantity
                   FROM BillOfMaterials b
                            JOIN Items p ON p.ItemID = b.ParentItemID
                   WHERE p.ItemCode = 'FG-FUT-003'
                     AND b.IsActive = 1
                   UNION ALL
                   SELECT b.ComponentItemID, CAST(e.Quantity * b.Quantity * (1 + b.ScrapRate / 100) AS DECIMAL(28, 8))
                   FROM Explosion e
                            JOIN BillOfMaterials b ON b.ParentItemID = e.ComponentItemID
                   WHERE b.IsActive = 1)
SELECT i.ItemCode,
       i.ItemName,
       CAST(SUM(e.Quantity) AS DECIMAL(18, 4))                                          AS Quantity,
       u.UnitCode,
       COALESCE((SELECT SUM(v.QuantityAvailable) FROM Inventory v WHERE v.ItemID = i.ItemID), 0) AS Available
FROM Explosion e
         JOIN Items i ON i.ItemID = e.ComponentItemID
         JOIN ItemType t ON t.ItemTypeID = i.ItemTypeID
         JOIN UnitOfMeasure u ON u.UnitID = i.UnitID
WHERE t.TypeCode = 'RAW'
GROUP BY i.ItemID, i.ItemCode, i.ItemName, u.UnitCode
ORDER BY i.ItemCode
OPTION (MAXRECURSION 0)

changes._why: starting from the BOM rows left out a finished good with no active component; it shows with no cost
request: Each finished futon's direct material cost, scrap included, and what remains of its list price; a futon without an active bill of materials shows NULL for both.
changes.sql:
SELECT p.ItemCode,
       p.ItemName,
       CAST(SUM(b.Quantity * (1 + b.ScrapRate / 100) * c.StandardCost) AS DECIMAL(18, 4))               AS MaterialCost,
       p.ListPrice,
       CAST(p.ListPrice - SUM(b.Quantity * (1 + b.ScrapRate / 100) * c.StandardCost) AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS Margin
FROM Items p
         JOIN ItemType t ON t.ItemTypeID = p.ItemTypeID
         LEFT JOIN BillOfMaterials b ON b.ParentItemID = p.ItemID AND b.IsActive = 1
         LEFT JOIN Items c ON c.ItemID = b.ComponentItemID
WHERE t.TypeCode = 'FG'
GROUP BY p.ItemID, p.ItemCode, p.ItemName, p.ListPrice
ORDER BY p.ItemCode

changes._why: nothing enforces positive quantities, known scrap rates, one unit, unique active pairs or raw materials being leaves, which the BOM exercises assume
changes.title: the BOM links that break the planning assumptions
request: The exercises on the bill of materials assume an active link has a positive quantity, a known scrap rate not below 0, the component's own unit, no twin, and a parent that is not a raw material; the schema enforces none of it.
Find the active links that break one of these; the check passes when nothing comes back.
changes.sql:
SELECT b.BOMID, p.ItemCode AS ParentCode, c.ItemCode AS ComponentCode, b.Quantity, b.ScrapRate, bu.UnitCode AS BOMUnit, cu.UnitCode AS StockUnit
FROM BillOfMaterials b
         JOIN Items p ON p.ItemID = b.ParentItemID
         JOIN ItemType pt ON pt.ItemTypeID = p.ItemTypeID
         JOIN Items c ON c.ItemID = b.ComponentItemID
         JOIN UnitOfMeasure bu ON bu.UnitID = b.UnitID
         JOIN UnitOfMeasure cu ON cu.UnitID = c.UnitID
WHERE b.IsActive = 1
  AND (b.Quantity <= 0
    OR b.ScrapRate IS NULL
    OR b.ScrapRate < 0
    OR b.UnitID <> c.UnitID
    OR pt.TypeCode = 'RAW'
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1
               FROM BillOfMaterials other
               WHERE other.ParentItemID = b.ParentItemID
                 AND other.ComponentItemID = b.ComponentItemID
                 AND other.IsActive = 1
                 AND other.BOMID <> b.BOMID))
ORDER BY p.ItemCode, c.ItemCode, b.BOMID

changes._why: CHK_BOM_NotSelf stops a direct self-reference only; the recursive exercises assume no cycle at all
changes.title: the items in a cycle of the bill of materials
request: The recursive exercises assume no item is, through any number of levels, a component of itself; the schema stops only the direct case.
Find the items in a cycle of active links; the check passes when nothing comes back.
Each path carries the items it has passed, and stops when it meets one again.
changes.sql:
WITH Walk AS (SELECT b.ParentItemID AS StartItemID,
                     b.ComponentItemID AS CurrentItemID,
                     CAST('/' + CAST(b.ParentItemID AS VARCHAR(11)) + '/' + CAST(b.ComponentItemID AS VARCHAR(11)) + '/' AS VARCHAR(MAX)) AS ItemPath,
                     0 AS IsCycle
              FROM BillOfMaterials b
              WHERE b.IsActive = 1
              UNION ALL
              SELECT w.StartItemID,
                     b.ComponentItemID,
                     CAST(w.ItemPath + CAST(b.ComponentItemID AS VARCHAR(11)) + '/' AS VARCHAR(MAX)),
                     CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('/' + CAST(b.ComponentItemID AS VARCHAR(11)) + '/', w.ItemPath) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
              FROM Walk w
                       JOIN BillOfMaterials b ON b.ParentItemID = w.CurrentItemID
              WHERE b.IsActive = 1
                AND w.IsCycle = 0)
SELECT DISTINCT i.ItemCode, i.ItemName
FROM Walk w
         JOIN Items i ON i.ItemID = w.StartItemID
WHERE w.IsCycle = 1
  AND w.CurrentItemID = w.StartItemID
ORDER BY i.ItemCode
OPTION (MAXRECURSION 0)

changes._why: InventoryTransaction and TransactionType are read by no exercise; a half-open month on a datetime2
changes.title: an item's inventory transactions in a month
request: The inventory transactions of RM-FILL-001 in November 2026, with the warehouse, the transaction type, the signed quantity, the unit cost recorded and the reference, in the order they happened.
The month runs from November 1 up to, not including, December 1, so every time of its last day is in.
changes.sql:
SELECT it.TransactionID, it.TransactionDate, w.WarehouseCode, tt.TypeCode, it.Quantity, it.UnitCost, it.ReferenceType, it.ReferenceNumber
FROM InventoryTransaction it
         JOIN Items i ON i.ItemID = it.ItemID
         JOIN Warehouse w ON w.WarehouseID = it.WarehouseID
         JOIN TransactionType tt ON tt.TransactionTypeID = it.TransactionTypeID
WHERE i.ItemCode = 'RM-FILL-001'
  AND it.TransactionDate >= '20261101'
  AND it.TransactionDate < '20261201'
ORDER BY it.TransactionDate, it.TransactionID

changes._why: the greatest row per group, with ROW_NUMBER, over the transactions no exercise reads
changes.title: the last movement of each item in the main warehouse
request: For each item in WH-MAIN, its last inventory transaction: the type, the quantity, what it refers to, and when.
`ROW_NUMBER` over each item, the latest first, keeps one row; `TransactionID` breaks a tie, and a transaction with no date comes last.
changes.sql:
WITH Ranked AS (SELECT t.ItemID,
                       t.TransactionTypeID,
                       t.Quantity,
                       t.ReferenceType,
                       t.ReferenceNumber,
                       t.TransactionDate,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.ItemID ORDER BY t.TransactionDate DESC, t.TransactionID DESC) AS Rn
                FROM InventoryTransaction t
                         JOIN Warehouse w ON w.WarehouseID = t.WarehouseID
                WHERE w.WarehouseCode = 'WH-MAIN')
SELECT i.ItemCode, i.ItemName, tt.TypeCode, r.Quantity, r.ReferenceType, r.ReferenceNumber, r.TransactionDate
FROM Ranked r
         JOIN Items i ON i.ItemID = r.ItemID
         JOIN TransactionType tt ON tt.TransactionTypeID = r.TransactionTypeID
WHERE r.Rn = 1
ORDER BY i.ItemCode

changes._why: PurchaseOrderDetail is read by no exercise; QuantityReceived is nullable, and the line number is no declared key
changes.title: the purchase-order lines still to receive
request: The lines of the purchase orders not cancelled whose quantity received is below the quantity ordered, or not recorded, with the supplier, the receiving warehouse and the expected delivery date, the earliest first and the undated last.
changes.sql:
SELECT po.PONumber, d.LineNumber, d.PODetailID, s.SupplierCode, w.WarehouseCode, i.ItemCode, d.Quantity, d.QuantityReceived,
       d.Quantity - d.QuantityReceived AS Outstanding, po.ExpectedDeliveryDate
FROM PurchaseOrder po
         JOIN PurchaseOrderDetail d ON d.PurchaseOrderID = po.PurchaseOrderID
         JOIN Supplier s ON s.SupplierID = po.SupplierID
         JOIN Warehouse w ON w.WarehouseID = po.WarehouseID
         JOIN Items i ON i.ItemID = d.ItemID
WHERE po.Status <> 'Cancelled'
  AND (d.QuantityReceived < d.Quantity OR d.QuantityReceived IS NULL)
ORDER BY CASE WHEN po.ExpectedDeliveryDate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, po.ExpectedDeliveryDate, po.PONumber, d.LineNumber, d.PODetailID

changes._why: SalesQuote is read by no exercise; its nullable ConvertedToOrderID is a Basic IS NULL
changes.title: the accepted quotes not turned into orders
request: The quotes a customer accepted that have not become an order yet, the oldest first.
changes.sql:
SELECT q.QuoteNumber, c.CustomerName, q.QuoteDate, q.ExpirationDate, q.TotalAmount
FROM SalesQuote q
         JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerID = q.CustomerID
WHERE q.Status = 'Accepted'
  AND q.ConvertedToOrderID IS NULL
ORDER BY q.QuoteDate, q.QuoteNumber

changes._why: returns and the link from a return line to its order line are read by no exercise; summed per line first, so a line returned twice counts once
changes.title: the share of each item returned
request: For each item sold on orders not cancelled, the quantity sold, the quantity returned, denied returns left out, and the share returned, the highest first.
The returns are summed per order line before the join, so a line returned more than once is not counted twice.
changes.sql:
SELECT i.ItemCode,
       i.ItemName,
       SUM(d.Quantity)                                                       AS Sold,
       SUM(COALESCE(r.Returned, 0))                                          AS Returned,
       CAST(SUM(COALESCE(r.Returned, 0)) * 100 / SUM(d.Quantity) AS DECIMAL(9, 2)) AS ReturnedPercent
FROM SalesOrderDetail d
         JOIN SalesOrder so ON so.SalesOrderID = d.SalesOrderID
         JOIN Items i ON i.ItemID = d.ItemID
         LEFT JOIN (SELECT rd.SODetailID, SUM(rd.QuantityReturned) AS Returned
                    FROM SalesReturnDetail rd
                             JOIN SalesReturn sr ON sr.ReturnID = rd.ReturnID
                    WHERE sr.Status <> 'Denied'
                    GROUP BY rd.SODetailID) r ON r.SODetailID = d.SODetailID
WHERE so.Status <> 'Cancelled'
GROUP BY i.ItemID, i.ItemCode, i.ItemName
ORDER BY ReturnedPercent DESC, i.ItemCode

changes._why: ReturnReason is read by no exercise; the line refunds summed, not the header's
changes.title: the quantities returned and refunded, by reason and item
request: For the returns received or refunded, the quantity returned and the line refunds by reason and item, with the number of original order lines affected, the largest refund first.
changes.sql:
SELECT rr.ReasonCode, rr.ReasonDescription, i.ItemCode, i.ItemName,
       COUNT(DISTINCT d.SODetailID) AS SalesLines,
       SUM(d.QuantityReturned)      AS QuantityReturned,
       SUM(d.RefundAmount)          AS RefundAmount
FROM SalesReturn r
         JOIN ReturnReason rr ON rr.ReturnReasonID = r.ReturnReasonID
         JOIN SalesReturnDetail d ON d.ReturnID = r.ReturnID
         JOIN Items i ON i.ItemID = d.ItemID
WHERE r.Status IN ('Received', 'Refunded')
GROUP BY rr.ReturnReasonID, rr.ReasonCode, rr.ReasonDescription, i.ItemID, i.ItemCode, i.ItemName
ORDER BY RefundAmount DESC, rr.ReasonCode, i.ItemCode

changes._why: no exercise covers production; two dates compared, and the nullable work center by an outer join
changes.title: the production orders completed late
request: The production orders completed after their planned completion date, with the item and the work center, if any, the earliest planned first.
changes.sql:
SELECT po.WorkOrderNumber, i.ItemCode, wc.WorkCenterCode, po.PlannedCompletionDate, po.ActualCompletionDate
FROM ProductionOrder po
         JOIN Items i ON i.ItemID = po.ItemID
         LEFT JOIN WorkCenter wc ON wc.WorkCenterID = po.WorkCenterID
WHERE po.Status = 'Completed'
  AND po.ActualCompletionDate > po.PlannedCompletionDate
ORDER BY po.PlannedCompletionDate, po.WorkOrderNumber

changes._why: the open production orders, the work center not yet assigned kept by an outer join
changes.title: the open production schedule
request: The production orders planned, released or in progress, with their item, warehouse, work center, priority and planned completion, the known dates first, the earliest first.
changes.sql:
SELECT po.WorkOrderNumber, i.ItemCode, w.WarehouseCode, wc.WorkCenterCode, po.Status, po.Priority, po.PlannedCompletionDate
FROM ProductionOrder po
         JOIN Items i ON i.ItemID = po.ItemID
         JOIN Warehouse w ON w.WarehouseID = po.WarehouseID
         LEFT JOIN WorkCenter wc ON wc.WorkCenterID = po.WorkCenterID
WHERE po.Status IN ('Planned', 'Released', 'InProgress')
ORDER BY CASE WHEN po.PlannedCompletionDate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, po.PlannedCompletionDate,
         CASE WHEN po.Priority IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, po.Priority, po.WorkOrderNumber

changes._why: the Intermediate exercise of production: COALESCE in a join, NULL-safe sums, a guarded share
changes.title: the scrap rate of each work center
request: For each work center, what its completions made and scrapped, and the share scrapped, the worst first; a completion without a work center counts for its production order's.
changes.sql:
SELECT wc.WorkCenterCode,
       wc.WorkCenterName,
       SUM(pc.QuantityCompleted)             AS Completed,
       SUM(COALESCE(pc.QuantityScrapped, 0)) AS Scrapped,
       CAST(SUM(COALESCE(pc.QuantityScrapped, 0)) * 100
           / NULLIF(SUM(pc.QuantityCompleted + COALESCE(pc.QuantityScrapped, 0)), 0) AS DECIMAL(9, 2)) AS ScrapPercent
FROM ProductionCompletion pc
         JOIN ProductionOrder po ON po.ProductionOrderID = pc.ProductionOrderID
         JOIN WorkCenter wc ON wc.WorkCenterID = COALESCE(pc.WorkCenterID, po.WorkCenterID)
GROUP BY wc.WorkCenterID, wc.WorkCenterCode, wc.WorkCenterName
ORDER BY ScrapPercent DESC, wc.WorkCenterCode

changes._why: ProductionOrderMaterial is read by no exercise; summed per order and item before the join to stock
changes.title: the production materials still to issue
request: For the open production orders, each material still to issue and its stock in the order's warehouse, `0` where none is stocked; a material whose quantity issued is not recorded is counted apart.
changes.sql:
WITH Materials AS (SELECT m.ProductionOrderID,
                          m.ItemID,
                          SUM(m.RequiredQuantity - m.IssuedQuantity)               AS Remaining,
                          SUM(CASE WHEN m.IssuedQuantity IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UnknownIssued
                   FROM ProductionOrderMaterial m
                   GROUP BY m.ProductionOrderID, m.ItemID)
SELECT po.WorkOrderNumber,
       i.ItemCode,
       w.WarehouseCode,
       CASE WHEN m.UnknownIssued = 0 THEN m.Remaining END AS Remaining,
       COALESCE(v.QuantityAvailable, 0)                  AS Available,
       m.UnknownIssued
FROM Materials m
         JOIN ProductionOrder po ON po.ProductionOrderID = m.ProductionOrderID
         JOIN Items i ON i.ItemID = m.ItemID
         JOIN Warehouse w ON w.WarehouseID = po.WarehouseID
         LEFT JOIN Inventory v ON v.ItemID = m.ItemID AND v.WarehouseID = po.WarehouseID
WHERE po.Status IN ('Planned', 'Released', 'InProgress')
  AND (m.Remaining > 0 OR m.UnknownIssued > 0)
ORDER BY po.WorkOrderNumber, i.ItemCode
